verdict.rationale: Wise documents card-level spend controls, but no department or program budgets with automatically enforced amount limits. Its controls are MCC/currency rules and transaction-type permissions, which are adjacent controls rather than budget enforcement.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can set department or program budgets with automatically enforced spend limits

citations.quote: Control which card transactions are permitted by creating rules based on merchant category code (MCC) or transaction currency.
Control spending permissions (e-commerce, ATM, contactless, magnetic stripe, etc.)
